title: Zesty Syrian Ikura Tagine
description: A spicy and indulgent Syrian dish featuring ikura, cooked to tender perfection in a bain-marie, and friendly to ayurvedic-rajasic diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the ikura and continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the ikura and sauce over rice or with crusty bread.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
